name: Write a file, then wait for approval
description: A writer agent commits a file on agent/<run>/writer; the run then pauses at a gate until someone approves or rejects, and on approval a tool node lists the writer's worktree.

steps.instructions: Read the README, then add a short NOTES.md that summarises what this repository is for, and commit it.

steps.title: Approve the notes
steps.prompt: Check the writer's summary before the run continues.
